steps: Every lizard's genes shape its body and its mind, and its form is the races it has really run. Read the form, then back a lizard to win or to place. It's all play money.
This is Betting from the full game, stripped down: the same engine and the same races. Everyone bets on the same race.
The extra fun is in the full game: Battle, where you and a rival race thirty lizards each over six races, and soon, buying and breeding your own stable.
